sourceReferenceSemantics.path: Repository-relative source file that was inspected for this inventory.
sourceReferenceSemantics.symbol: When non-null, the exact named function or component present in that file. null denotes file-level evidence only and never asserts a symbol identity.
sourceReferenceSemantics.mutationActionRule: Every mutation cites exact exported production Server Actions. Non-mutating client-triggered Server Actions are also cited when they implement downloads, calculations or previews.
sourceReferenceSemantics.uiActionRule: Every action cites its exact route page export (or a null-symbol file reference only when that page has no named default export). Route-level sources retain the supporting component graph.

moduleSemantics.navigationModule: Nullable navigation visibility metadata resolved from artifacts/backoffice/src/lib/navigation/route-registry.ts; it is not an authorization module.
moduleSemantics.routeAvailabilityModules: Effective tenant authorization modules derived from permission resources through FIELDGRID_PERMISSION_MODULES plus explicit runtime module checks. Registry module strings never replace these values.
moduleSemantics.actionAvailabilityModules: Effective runtime modules for the action-specific permission or explicit module checks, evaluated in addition to route availability.

availabilitySemantics.baseFields: Within one availability object, allPermissions, modules, featureFlags, planEntitlements and tenantSettings are conjunctive; anyPermissions requires at least one listed permission when the list is non-empty.
availabilitySemantics.anyOf: When present, anyOf is an OR over complete availability clauses. Every clause uses the same six fields and is internally conjunctive. This models source expressions such as settings access OR planning access plus the planning module without flattening away a module gate.
availabilitySemantics.routeComposition: An action availability is evaluated in the context of its routeAvailability unless the action is global. It does not replace the route gate.

authorizationSemantics.availability: Compatibility projection of the currently observed production UI gate; it intentionally equals uiAvailabilityObserved.
authorizationSemantics.uiAvailabilityObserved: Audit evidence of what the current UI actually renders or enables. It is not automatically the desired Fieldflow Calm authorization and known legacy defects must not be copied forward.
authorizationSemantics.serverAuthorization: Minimum forged-call authorization observed in the exact cited Server Action. UI-only navigation actions have an empty serverAuthorization because no Server Action is invoked.
authorizationSemantics.knownMismatch: false means no audited UI/server or source/target discrepancy is known for this action. A string records an existing production mismatch or explicitly named contract gap that implementation must reconcile, not preserve.
authorizationSemantics.preconditionsAndEffects: preconditions describe record, status, ownership, lifecycle or data facts in addition to authorization; effects describe the observable UI, navigation, session, audit, revalidation or domain result. confirmation remains an independent user-safety contract.
authorizationSemantics.sourcePreconditionRule: A *.source-precondition record is an action-specific human index of the observed page context, not a second lossy copy of every branch inside production code. The exact predicate authority is the cited path#symbol on the pinned production blob, reached from the exact route page through the validated static import graph. Implementation must preserve and re-audit that complete predicate; the summary may never override or weaken it.
authorizationSemantics.securityRule: Fieldflow Calm must render the reconciled least-privilege gate and keep the Server Action at least equally restrictive; uiAvailabilityObserved is evidence, never permission to reproduce a weaker UI gate.

sourceCoverage.rule: Named exported Server Actions imported by use-client modules are linked to actionIds or explicitly excluded. Type-only imports and non-exported symbols are not counted.
